youtube_description:
In videos Relativity 1 & 2 we developed the theory needed to analyze the celebrated "Twin Paradox" which shows how the dilation factor (beta) we needed to introduce predicts that someone who makes a spaceflight will age more slowly than someone who stays on Earth.
